title: Add exact shared correction basis across P112 frames
body:
## Result

This adds an exact local mechanism for sharing the rank-8 correction basis between two distinct orthogonal frames in the selected P112 plane-upgrade model. It follows the pair-sharing question raised by philippeVV's single-frame probe in Discussion #2278.

The pinned selected 112 q labels are mapped bijectively to P112 by checking their complete binary pairing and all eight deleted-frame signatures. The verifier then enumerates all 1,260 P112 frames, all 135 common directions, and all 1,539,720 same-direction frame pairs (20,160 frame-direction correction blocks). For every fixed direction, every block factors exactly through one rational rank-8 basis. The common denominator is 2; writing the basis as `M0/2` gives integer coefficient matrices whose combined F2 row span has rank 4. The certificate's explicit witness pair has F2 coefficient rank 1.

Under the pinned matrix-coefficient price model, charging one shared correction at +8 gives an exact selected-profile relaxation of 0.999388703606489 at the conservative 5% target. The one-frame +8 case (1.000367800102208) and the two-frame unshared +16 case (1.000490187164172) fail that screen.

## Scope

This is a shared correction mechanism and favorable local moment screen, not a completed multiplication supplier, conditional bound, or new κ. The denominator-2 basis requires precision accounting. Source access, copies, legal frame schedule, hosting, transitions, restoration, all-size realization, and the matching bit-side construction remain unpriced or unbuilt.

The current P104 pooled correction-space result in Discussion #2245 / PR #2251 concerns a different trace, target matrices and timing model. This package works on selected P112 same-direction frame pairs. It also differs from PR #1825's paired plane decoder, Discussion #2126's 56 shared matched planes, the tri-plane work in Discussion #2024 / PR #2041, and the five-dimensional cover claim in Discussion #2292.

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/cycle47-shared-frame-correction/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/cycle47-shared-frame-correction --check-only
```

The exact verifier passes on local Python 3.14.7; package metadata and source pins pass the repository check. Registered CI replay is configured for Python 3.12.

Source, predecessor, base-commit and selected-record pins, exhaustive domain, exact arithmetic, positive controls, and two meaningful negative controls are in `research/cycle47-shared-frame-correction/`.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The #2278 single-frame probe and cited predecessor work remain attributed in the package. No independent human review is claimed.
